content.intro: Learn creating and retrieving records through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Creating and Retrieving Records matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines creating and retrieving records as part of the django orm and querysets. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.
